label: D30-tampilan-riwayat-tap
decision: How should the card detail screen present the local 30-day tap history (FR-30), given that it currently shows only the 20 newest rows under a '30 hari' heading with no way to reach older entries?

candidates.description: Render every entry from the last 30 days inline in the detail history section; the Settings -> Delete section sits below all entries.
Show the 5 most recent entries inline, then a 'Lihat semua (n)' navigation row (only when more exist) that opens a full screen listing all 30-day entries, newest first.
Replace the inline section with one 'Riwayat tap (n)' navigation row that opens the full 30-day list; no entries inline.
Keep 20 rows inline, rename the heading to '20 tap terakhir', and store only the 20 most recent entries per card.

priorities: 1) FR-30: every tap from the last 30 days must be viewable. 2) The detail stays scannable: one primary action, and FR-31's Settings -> Delete reachable without long scrolling (O-S11). 3) Usable at AX5 text size (NFR-A01). 4) Minimal new UI and strings (ID+EN).
requirements: Every tap entry from the last 30 days can be viewed in the app.
The Settings -> Delete section stays reachable without scrolling past a long list of history rows.
The most recent taps are visible on the detail screen without extra navigation.
